catalog.name: Dagon (devnet preview)
catalog.description: Hide, reveal and swap Dagon's test tokens on devnet
catalog.about: A preview of Dagon, by Inkwell Finance, on Solana devnet. It moves Dagon's test tokens into a hidden balance kept by the Encrypt network, reveals that balance when you ask, and swaps one test token for the other. On devnet nothing is actually encrypted yet, and the tokens have no value.
catalog.usage: Activate once, then hide test tokens, reveal a hidden balance or swap. Every operation is listed under In progress until Encrypt finishes it.

actions.hide: Move test tokens into a hidden balance
actions.reveal: Reveal a hidden balance, for a small devnet fee
actions.swap: Swap one hidden test token for the other

notice.title: Devnet preview
notice.body: Amounts are not actually encrypted yet, and these test tokens have no value.

unavailable.title: Dagon is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: Its devnet setup could not be read or did not match what this wallet expects.

activate.label: Activate
activate.body: Activating sets up one Dagon account per test token: one confirmation each.

card.readFailed: Could not read the balance. Tap Reveal to try again.

sheet.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to 2 decimals.

warnings.publicAmount: The amount is public on Solana. Only the balance it joins is hidden.
warnings.withdrawPublic: The amount becomes public. If Encrypt fails, it can stay stuck on devnet with no refund.
warnings.minimumCaveat: You receive at least the minimum, or nothing moves. Devnet does not enforce the minimum yet.
warnings.revealCost: A reveal is a transaction and costs about 0.0023 devnet SOL of rent that is not returned.
warnings.sendOutcome: Only a reveal tells you whether the amount moved.
